recipes.name: Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 1/4 tsp chilli powder ((adjust spiciness to taste))
instructions: Makes 2.5 tablespoons. Combine with 1lbs/500g mince meat, 1/2 cup water, 1 diced onion and 2 tablespoons of tomato paste.

page_recipe_notes: Recipe Notes: 1. If you are in the US, do not use what you know as Chili Powder. That is a spice blend, not pure ground chilies. If you can’t find pure ground chili, substitute with cayenne pepper. I like to make this Taco Seasoning with pure ground chili so I can control the flavour consistency – US Chili Powder is not available around the world and also even from brand to brand, the flavour differs. Using pure spice ingredients allows for better consistency.
